title: eugenia coriacea
intro: Eugenia coriacea, commonly known as the Umbu tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. It is native to the Atlantic Forest in Brazil and is valued for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits. The Eugenia coriacea tree has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and inflammation, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Eugenia coriacea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
